### Music

While 2025 may not have delivered a wave of huge pop culture moments like its predecessor, it was still a strong year for music streaming. Major global artists continued to dominate, while K-Pop, Country and Pop music soared. Meanwhile, Spotify was there to help you listen along all year round.

#### Most-Streamed Artists Globally in 2025

Bad Bunny is Spotify’s 2025 Global Top Artist, with more than 19.8 billion streams. He reclaims the top spot for the fourth time, after previously being the most-streamed artist in 2020, 2021, and 2022. He’s followed by Taylor Swift (#2), The Weeknd (#3), Drake (#4), and Billie Eilish (#5).

To mark Bad Bunny’s achievement, Spotify is celebrating with fan experiences, a global film launch, on-platform easter eggs, and more. [...] Here’s the Global Top 10 Artists of 2025:

title: The Top Artists, Songs, Albums, Podcasts, and Audiobooks of 2025
content:
## Bad Bunny is once again Spotify’s Global Top Artist

For the fourth time, after claiming the title in 2020, 2021, and 2022, our users have crowned Bad Bunny Spotify’s top artist globally, with 19.8 billion streams this year. He also clinched the global top album of 2025 with DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS. To celebrate this achievement, Spotify is launching a global campaign honoring the superstar and his fans, including a short film, Leap Year, unique fan activations around the globe, and on-platform surprises.

Rounding out the top five artists are Taylor Swift in second place (but first in the U.S.), followed by The Weeknd (third), Drake (fourth), and Billie Eilish (fifth).

## The trends that shaped our year

### Music [...] The year in music was marked by the return of a global superstar to the top spot, powerful collaborations that became instant classics, and a film soundtrack that took the world by storm. Meanwhile, in the world of podcasts and audiobooks, long-running fan favorites continued their dominance while the fantasy genre proved its undeniable power.

So how did the world listen in 2025? Read on for the full breakdown.

## Bad Bunny is once again Spotify’s Global Top Artist [...] On the global albums list, Bad Bunny’s DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS came out on top this year. But the influence of the screen was also undeniable, as KPop Demon Hunters (Soundtrack from the Netflix Film) captured the number-two spot. And showing the staying power of a blockbuster release, Billie Eilish’s HIT ME HARD AND SOFT and Sabrina Carpenter’s Short n’ Sweet both returned to the top five for the second year in a row.

### Podcasts

For the sixth consecutive year, The Joe Rogan Experience was Spotify’s top podcast globally, followed by The Diary Of A CEO with Steven Bartlett and The Mel Robbins Podcast in second and third place, respectively.

title: Spotify Most-Streamed Artists of 2025 - ChartMasters
content:
Usual suspects from Canada, The Weeknd and Drake, rank at #3 and #4, respectively, both down one spot from last year. This means 2025 is the fourth year in a row in which the same quartet has exchanged positions in the top 4 spots.

Billie Eilish and Ariana Grande confirmed their magnificent 2024 year, repeating positions at #5 and #6. The former topped 10 billion streams this year, the second time in a row.

Arijit Singh makes history, becoming the first Indian artist to claim a top 10 position thanks to nearly 9 billion streams. [...] Between studio albums, collaborations, and mixtapes, he has now released 16 significant projects. All of them are past 1.5 billion streams, and 15 of them still add over a million streams per day, including 9 at 2+ million. To give a point of comparison, his prime challengers in the late 2010s, Ed Sheeran and Post Malone, have only four albums each, currently pacing over a million daily streams. His lone 2025 album, Some Sexy Songs 4 U with PartyNextDoor, did well, on its way to top 2 billion streams.

Surpassed by Bad Bunny during the year, Drake ranks as the third most-streamed artist in total with 97 billion lead streams. He is still the leader once we factor in features, thanks to 126 billion plays.

### 3 (2) The Weeknd – 13.31 billion streams [...] ### 4 (3) Drake – 12.64 billion streams

We reach the Big Four of streaming. These artists have been pacing at 30+ million daily streams for years. They have been the four most-streamed artists in each of 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025. At #4, Drake, who remains incredibly consistent despite the bad press of recent years. His last huge album was 2018’s Scorpion, but his stacked catalog and continued prolificity enable him to pull large amounts of streams year after year.

Elsewhere, the trio of albums collectively delivered the biggest first 24-hour streaming debut globally for any artist on Amazon Music in 2026.

Page semi-protected

The following list contains the most-streamed artists on the audio streaming platform Spotify. As of April 2026, Taylor Swift is the most-streamed artist in Spotify's history. Bad Bunny is the most-streamed male artist.

Since 2013, Spotify has published a yearly list of its most-streamed artists, which has been topped by Bad Bunny a record four times (2020–2022; 2025), being the only artist to do so in three consecutive years. Drake "Drake (musician)") has topped the list three times (2015–2016; 2018), while Swift is the only female artist to have topped the list (2023–2024).
